hero.heading: About Me
hero.tagline: Designing with Purpose, Creating with Passion

bio.paragraph1: A passionate graphic designer with a love for creating meaningful and impactful designs.
bio.paragraph2: I'm currently pursuing my Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design at Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM), where I'm honing my skills and expanding my creative horizons. My journey in design started with a simple fascination for visual storytelling, and it has evolved into a full-fledged passion.
bio.paragraph3: I believe that good design is more than just aesthetics - it's about solving problems, communicating ideas, and creating experiences that resonate with people. Whether I'm working on branding, print materials, or digital graphics, I approach each project with dedication and attention to detail.
bio.paragraph4: When I'm not designing, you can find me exploring new design trends, experimenting with different creative techniques, or seeking inspiration from the world around me. I'm always excited to take on new challenges and collaborate with clients who value quality design.
